messages:
alex: Noticed a misleading example in /v1/generate. The request example shows an array payload `[{"prompt":"..."}]` but the API expects an object `{"input":"..."}`. This breaks our snippet extractor and SDK examples.

riley: Where is the file?

alex: docs/generate.md and openapi/examples/generate.json. Current snippet:
```json
[{"prompt":"Summarize this"}]
```
Should be:
```json
{"input":"Summarize this"}
```

marta: cc @samir SDKs will generate wrong call signatures if this stays. Also the response example uses `text` as a string; schema uses `choices: [{"text":"..."}]`.

samir: Will pause publishing SDK snippet changes until docs are fixed. Can you add a short migration note for users referencing older examples?

alex: Yep — adding a one-line note: "Older docs used an array body; use {"input":...} in current API." Also fixing response example to `choices` array and keeping param names (`max_new_tokens`, `temperature`). Pushing a docs-only PR in ~15m.

docsbot: examples-lint: failed on docs/generate.md:78 — response shape mismatch. CI: https://ci.redwood/linters/11011

riley: After you push, update snippets/js/generate.ts and snippets/python/generate_example.py so the site shows consistent examples.

alex: PR opened at 1735551310: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2509 — request/response examples fixed, openapi example updated, migration note added.

samir: Will update extraction after merge and open SDK PR referencing commit hash.

marta: Quick review checklist: list changed files, migration note header, keep `max_new_tokens`, run `yarn docs:build`, smoke-check rendered page. Will review now.

alex: Merged at 1735551389. Thanks all. Closing follow-up issue #621.
